is: One tick of the spawner, split into a pure planner, the .zaf/spawn.state slot file, and the I/O that reserves slots, launches team instances through the Runner port and records them on the epic.
conventions: tick.rs stays pure (no port, no file); every side effect lives in mod.rs
Launch and exit are HTML-comment markers on the epic: `<!-- zaf:launch <instance> -->`, `<!-- zaf:exit <instance> <status> -->`

fs.name: tick.rs
fs.role: board snapshot, state, guard and settings in, launch plan out

notes: Only the team-instance branch is built; tick.rs names planning, challenger and release as NOT_BUILT and skips them, and the teams README says so
The verb never loops; an external timer runs `zaf spawn --once`
The launch prompt and standing brief are assets/spawn/team-prompt.txt and team-brief.md
Slots and guard thresholds come from ZAF.toml [spawn]; the guard level is read from .zaf/guard.json; a batch of tasks shares one instance and one slot
